description: Column 2 (third from left) holds exactly one stone. Fires strongly when the opponent has just dropped that stone into the empty column 2, especially in the opening; it weakens as stones pile up in row 1 and above (bottom-row stones barely matter). If the single col-2 stone was played earlier it fires only weakly, mainly when it is the opponent's. Never fires when col 2 has 0 or 2+ stones.
effect: Small and position-specific: forcing it high or zero moves single columns by at most about 5 points (e.g. zeroing at 6,5,6,2 lowers col 2 by 4 points; at 3,3,3,3,2 shifts about 5 points between cols 1 and 4). No consistent push toward a column.
notes: H1 (col2 bottom stone theirs, col2 height 1) F1 0.44; adding ply cutoffs 0.53; linear estimate with row-weighted penalty and ownership-weighted residual 0.62 (best, p5, sim 0.62). Act: just-played col-2 bottom stone fires at ply 4 in every case tried (2.7-5.5); col 2 stone at row 1+ never (<0.4); effect is board- not move-order-dependent. Residual (non-just-played) cases near threshold are noisy and drive most errors; late-game just-played cases with full bottom rows are under-predicted. Two sequences beat dev max (5.68, 5.58).
